exec_summary.purpose: This simulation assessed the security posture of the target system and tested its defenses against a controlled AI-driven malware attack.

scope.techniques: Standard AI simulation, benign telemetry generation, lab-scoped scanning techniques. Passive discovery, consented active scanning, simulated C2 exchanges, and non-persistent dummy actions.
phases: Phase 2 - C2 Simulation & Dummy Actions (Controlled Emulation)

ai_models.name: Evasion AI
ai_models.role: Payload-side model that adapts actions to reduce detection signals observed from simulated detectors.

ai_models.name: Recon Prioritisation AI
ai_models.role: Server-side model that ranks reconnaissance findings by risk and operational relevance.

ai_models.name: Attack Decision AI
ai_models.role: Server-side planner that selects the next simulated action based on priorities and evasion feedback.

recon_data.vpn_dmz: DMZ present for web-facing hosts; internal admin subnet protected via VPN
misconfigurations: SMB fallback to SMBv1 supported on Samba (legacy protocol enabled)

findings.name: Sensitive Files in Public Directory
findings.impact: Confidential data exposure; risk of exfiltration

findings.name: Open SMB Port
findings.evidence: Port 445 open on host; Samba 4.11 with SMBv1 support
findings.impact: Could allow remote exploitation and lateral movement

findings.name: World-readable public directory
findings.impact: Exposure of sensitive files to unauthenticated users

evasion.vm_detection: No conclusive VM/sandbox detection heuristics triggered; minor timing-based heuristics observed
skipped: Credential dumping (skipped due to high detection risk)
Local privilege escalation exploit (skipped; unsafe in lab)

attacks.name: Dummy file exfiltration
attacks.description: Simulated exfiltration of non-sensitive placeholder files to a benign sink; no actual data exfiltration performed.

attacks.name: Simulated lateral movement
attacks.description: Attempted lateral movement via discovered SMB share; simulation used inert probes only.

attacks.name: Privilege escalation (simulated)
attacks.description: Simulated attempt to escalate privileges; full exploit not executed; check for vulnerable services and config.

mitigations: Remove sensitive files from public directories and enforce least-privilege ACLs on /home/test/public.
Disable SMBv1 support on Samba and apply vendor patches; restrict SMB to internal subnets only.
Update nginx to the latest stable version and apply security patches (address CVE-2021-23017).
Ensure AV signatures are up-to-date and configure more frequent scans; enable behavioral rules where possible.
Harden logging and monitoring: add host-based EDR with behavior analysis and centralize alerts for correlation.
Review user privileges; remove unused privileged accounts and enable multi-factor authentication for admin users.
